dialogue.arabic: أهلا فيك. وإنت، من زمان شوفير؟
dialogue.english: Thanks. And you, have you been a driver long?

dialogue.speaker: Abu Ali
dialogue.arabizi: tletin sene. ana kenet m3allem 2abl l 7arb.
dialogue.arabic: تلاتين سنة. أنا كنت معلّم قبل الحرب.
dialogue.english: Thirty years. I was a teacher before the war.

dialogue.speaker: Abu Ali
dialogue.arabizi: kellon barra. wa7ad bel Dubai, w wa7ad bel Almanya.
dialogue.arabic: كلّن برّا. واحد بدبي، وواحد بألمانيا.
dialogue.english: All abroad. One in Dubai, one in Germany.

dialogue.speaker: Abu Ali
dialogue.arabizi: ktir. bas hayda Lebnen... 7elo, bas l dawle...
dialogue.arabic: كتير. بس هيدا لبنان... حلو، بس الدولة...
dialogue.english: A lot. But that's Lebanon... beautiful, but the state...

dialogue.speaker: Abu Ali
dialogue.english: My pleasure! And say hi to Canada for me!

questions.q: What was the driver before the war?

items.english: What are we doing today, dear?

items.arabizi: brushing w ma tensé l volume
items.english: A blow-dry and don't forget the volume
I want to change the colour
Did you hear about the neighbours' daughter?

items.arabizi: l coiffeuse bta3ref kel l akhbar
items.english: The hairdresser knows all the news
You'll come out like the moon

dialogue.speaker: Nadine
dialogue.arabizi: ahla Maya! shu mna3mel l yom ya 2albe?
dialogue.arabic: أهلا مايا! شو منعمل اليوم يا قلبي؟
dialogue.english: Hi Maya! What are we doing today, dear?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabizi: brushing, w badde ghayyer l lawn shway. ashkar?
dialogue.arabic: برشينغ، وبدّي غيّر اللون شوي. أشقر؟
dialogue.english: A blow-dry, and I want to change the colour a bit. Blonde?

dialogue.speaker: Nadine
dialogue.english: Honey blonde, very nice in summer!

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.english: Go on. And what's the news?

dialogue.speaker: Nadine
dialogue.arabizi: sme3te 3an Lina w Tony? 7a yetjawwazo b aylul!
dialogue.arabic: سمعتي عن لينا وطوني؟ رح يتجوّزوا بأيلول!
dialogue.english: Did you hear about Lina and Tony? They're getting married in September!

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabic: إيه، أنا عرفت! أنا رح كون إشبينة!
dialogue.english: Yes, I know! I'm going to be the maid of honour!

dialogue.speaker: Nadine
dialogue.arabic: يا عيني! يعني بتجي عندي قبل العرس؟
dialogue.english: How lovely! So you'll come to me before the wedding?

dialogue.speaker: Nadine
dialogue.arabizi: ...w hayda. na3iman! 7a tetla3e metl l amar.
dialogue.english: ...There you go. Enjoy! You look like the moon.

questions.q: When are Lina and Tony getting married?
What will Maya be at the wedding?

items.note: Never just one 'bye'.

items.english: Let us know when you arrive
I don't say goodbye, I say 'until we meet'

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.arabizi: eh, teta. shahr bi Kanada, w mnerja3.
dialogue.english: Yes, Teta. A month in Canada, and we'll be back.

dialogue.speaker: Teta
dialogue.arabic: رح نشتقلكن كتير. ما تغيبوا عنّا!
dialogue.english: We'll miss you so much. Don't be strangers!

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabizi: abadan teta. mna3mel video call kel yom.
dialogue.arabic: أبدًا تيتا. منعمل فيديو كول كل يوم.
dialogue.english: Never, Teta. We'll video call every day.

dialogue.speaker: Teta
dialogue.english: And let us know when you land.

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.arabizi: akid. w jiblik shi men Kanada?
dialogue.english: Of course. Shall I bring you something from Canada?

dialogue.speaker: Teta
dialogue.arabizi: bas erja3o b salame. hayda kel shi.
dialogue.arabic: بس ارجعوا بسلامة. هيدا كل شي.
dialogue.english: Just come back safely. That's all.

dialogue.speaker: Teta
dialogue.arabizi: allah ma3kon. ma3 l salame... w l bab maftou7 dayman.
dialogue.arabic: الله معكن. مع السلامة... والباب مفتوح دايمًا.
dialogue.english: God be with you. Go in peace... and the door is always open.

questions.q: How long will they be in Canada?
What does Teta want from Canada?
options: Just for them to come back safely

questions.q: How will they stay in touch?
